name: WOE active rubric stewardship measurement renewed runtime
summary: Renewed active reviewed canonical rubric47 measurement after staging runtime drift. Original operational executor supplied stable fresh runtime witnesses; unchanged source and mutation proof remain separately authoritative.

assertions.evidence: {"criterionClass":"violatable","model":"The holder reviews selected work and the unowned frontier each operating window, reuses suitable active rubrics and routes only genuine coverage gaps through proposal and independent ratification. A rubric proposal alone is not coverage.","method":"For the exact goal/holder/window, read the selected worklist and the holder reports/plan decisions. Enumerate important targets and their active rubric revision or evidenced gap. Re-run rubrics:search/get for reuse decisions. Follow each proposed rubric through independent ratification or justified rejection. Pass requires a recorded coverage review and an accountable disposition for every gap; fail when a material in-scope target has no reviewed standard or owned gap. Unknown requires an explicit missing-source action, never inferred coverage.","driftMarkers":"Fail if the holder skips the operating-window review, silently invents a duplicate rubric, presents an unratified proposal as active coverage or drops a discovered gap without an owner.","replication":"REPLICATION DRILL: pin goalId, holder lease and window; reconstruct the selected-target population from canonical goal portfolio; replay each cited rubric read and coverage/gap decision. Negative control: a selected important target with neither rubric nor owned gap must fail. Positive control: reuse of an active suitable rubric with a recorded coverage review is assessable."}

{"criterionClass":"violatable","model":"The holder reviews vague criteria, weak falsifiers, recurring unknowns and outcome blind spots, records an evidence-backed keep/amend decision, and delegates reviewed versioned changes while preserving historical comparability.","method":"Read exact-window quality-review decisions and the immutable revisions of cited rubrics. Tie each keep/amend decision to scorecard evidence, drift or real outcomes. Check proposal/ratification provenance and preserve prior criteria. Pass requires a substantive review with justified keep decisions or verified changes; fail on no review, unexplained weakening or unowned material defects. Count neither edits nor rubric proliferation as quality by themselves.","driftMarkers":"Fail if criteria are weakened to improve the score, blind spots recur without an accountable decision, existing criteria are lost or a rubric revision is changed inside a before/after comparison without a new baseline.","replication":"REPLICATION DRILL: replay rubrics:get at each cited immutable revision, compare criterion/falsifier changes and review decisions against the original outcome evidence. Negative control: a lowered standard with no outcome improvement fails. Positive control: a reviewed unchanged rubric with a justified keep decision remains assessable without forcing an amendment."}

{"criterionClass":"violatable","model":"Each warranted cycle has a goal-attributed bounded GRADE assignment, exact target and pinned rubric revision, baseline before repair, owned confirmed remediation with recurrence guards, verified repairs and a terminal comparable re-grade. GOAL keeps the portfolio role. Required independent acceptance is preserved.","method":"Start from the goal detail rubricStewardship snapshot and canonical goal-stamped scorecards/work items. For each warranted cycle follow launch/claim evidence, baseline, repair references, completion evidence and linked terminal re-grade. Use classifyStewardshipCycle as a deterministic countercheck. Pass requires the window owed grading to be discharged through verified comparable cycles or an evidenced healthy baseline with no warranted repairs. Partial when a live owned cycle is progressing within its declared budget; fail when findings are abandoned, cycles exceed their exit budget without audit/reallocation, or launch/fix-only activity is called completion. Unknown sources remain explicit.","driftMarkers":"Fail on no warranted launch, no baseline-before-repair, unverified or foreign-goal repairs, changed target/revision without a new baseline, required self-acceptance, stale terminal evidence, duplicate live lanes or a stalled cycle repeatedly fed more agents.","replication":"REPLICATION DRILL: pin goal, target, rubric revision and operating window. Re-read canonical baseline and re-grade plus each linked completion; replay the named classifier regression suite. Counterexamples include foreign-goal repairs, unaudited scorecards, changed criteria hashes, repairs after the re-grade and implementer-as-final-grader. None may earn verified-improvement credit. Verify the baseline remains available as immutable history."}

criteria.title: Important in-scope targets have reviewed rubric coverage
Rubric quality is reviewed and improved through versioned evidence
Delegated grading reaches verified repairs and a comparable independent re-grade

procedure: Preflight requires a non-null independently measured runtime fingerprint. executeOperationalRun supplies timestamps, source snapshots and fresh before/after runtime observations. Read canonical rubrics:get and pin active revision47/hash; check three duties retain violatable class, substantive model, fail-oriented method, drift markers and replay drills. Contract-suite absence/failure/unknown positive-negative controls and copied mutation establish behavioral adequacy separately.
